description: Schema for Character Knowledge Module entries — defines required fields for every character reference file.

required_fields.name: Character display name (e.g., Zayd, Amira)
required_fields.role: Character role (e.g., Lead Boy, Lead Girl, Elder / Recurring Grandfather, Father, Mother, Recurring Mascot — Lamb)
required_fields.age_description: Age and type description (e.g., 5-year-old Muslim boy character, small fluffy white lamb mascot character)
required_fields.locked_description_block: Exact text block describing appearance, clothing, expression, and pose. Must be copied word-for-word into any scene prompt. Never modified.
required_fields.master_turnaround_prompt: Full text of the master turnaround prompt used to generate and lock the character design reference.
required_fields.hero_portrait_prompt: Full text of the hero portrait prompt used for thumbnails and marketing.
required_fields.version_lock: Module-level version reference (v2.0 for module; individual character files maintain original design lock)
required_fields.render_suffix_reference: Reference to universal render suffix in character_system.md or character_render_rules.md — must be included unchanged at end of any scene prompt.
required_fields.consistency_reference: Reference to character_consistency_rules.md — all 4 rules must be satisfied in any multi-character scene.

output_format.structure: Header delimiter + Character title + Header delimiter + Locked Description Block + Master Turnaround Prompt + Hero Portrait Prompt + Closing delimiter (if present in original). Each section preserved exactly.
output_format.no_rewrite_policy: Every prompt preserved exactly from original attachment. No simplification, shortening, or rewriting allowed.

integration_rules: MASTER_PROMPT.md loads character files only through this module.
Only required character files are loaded per episode (via character_index.json).
Locked description blocks are copied exactly — never paraphrased.
Turnaround prompts are used only when creating new references; existing references are reused.
Universal render suffix must close every scene prompt using these characters.
Consistency rules from character_consistency_rules.md apply to every multi-character scene.
future_expansion: New characters: Add new .md file in characters/ + update character_index.json + update this schema if fields change.
New languages: Separate file (e.g., zayd_ar.md) — never overwrite original locked block.
New render engines: Update character_render_rules.md with new suffix — preserve original suffix.
Interactive content: Reference locked blocks directly — never alter original .md content.
audit_notes: All 6 character files present (zayd.md, amira.md, dada_yusuf.md, baba_ahmad.md, ummi_layla.md, nuri.md).
All original prompts preserved exactly — zero simplification, zero rewriting.
Zero broken references: All index entries point to existing files.
Zero contradictions: Module rules align with DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md, RULES.md, and MASTER_PROMPT.md.

optional_asset_fields._note: Added v2.22, extended v2.23 — additive extension for the incoming permanent character asset library. All fields optional, default null/empty until real approved assets exist. Existing required_fields above are unchanged and remain authoritative for visual identity; these fields extend, never override, locked_description_block. When the character master file is supplied, existing canonical repository data + approved asset data must be reconciled explicitly, never silently overwritten on either side.
optional_asset_fields.age: Numeric age, if distinct from age_description's prose (null until specified)
optional_asset_fields.profession: For non-lead/recurring characters with a role (e.g. doctor, teacher) — null until specified
optional_asset_fields.canonical_visual_prompt: Alias/synonym for locked_description_block in required_fields above — do not duplicate content, reference it
optional_asset_fields.canonical_negative_constraints: Explicit 'do not depict X' list per character, derived from content_restrictions.json where applicable (empty until populated)

voice_profile._note: All null until a real TTS voice is selected and approved — never guessed or placeholder-filled. Episode-level direction may vary emotion/energy/pace WITHIN this profile's allowed range but must never silently replace voice identity, accent, core pitch, age impression, or pronunciation.

sacred_entity_restriction_note: Per phase2/data/safety/content_restrictions.json (restriction_002/003): Allah must never become a character/image/voice asset under this schema. Prophets/Messengers must not automatically become reusable face/voice character assets — restriction_003's replacement strategy (narrate, don't depict) applies. This schema's optional_asset_fields must never be populated for those categories.
